intro.title: Welcome to our Medibank OSHC Interactive Activity!
intro.text: OSHC means Overseas Student Health Cover. In the next few minutes you will learn what it is, why you need it, and how to use it. There are 3 short sections. Each has one question.
intro.note: This is a practice activity. We do not ask for your name or any personal information.

sections.section_text: OSHC is health insurance for international students. It helps pay for doctor visits, some hospital care and ambulance services.
sections.question: Why do international students need OSHC?
options: It is a student visa requirement
It is only needed for sports
sections.correct_option: It is a student visa requirement
sections.explanation: You must have OSHC for the whole time your student visa is valid.

sections.section_title: How do I make a claim?
sections.section_text: After you see a doctor, you can claim back part of the cost. Keep your receipt. Always use Medibank's official website or app.
sections.question: What should you keep after a doctor visit?
sections.explanation: The receipt is proof of payment. You need it to make a claim.
